scope: Design-only, fail-closed acceptance checklist for a future V19 CP2 product-shell layout and draw-list implementation. It binds accepted CP1 but does not edit production, start CP2, authorize CMake, GPU, readiness, capture, or accept CP2.

layout_contract.canonical_orientation: z horizontal; HEAD/开球端 left; FOOT/底端 right; no anisotropic distortion
layout_contract.collision_or_below_minimum_behavior: suppress with exact reason; never overlap, shrink below minimum, move by camera/scene, or enable world overlay

bilingual_ui_contract.title: TRAJECTORY / 轨迹
legend_entries_in_order: ACTUAL / 实际 — paired continuous rails

zero_overlap_and_exclusion_contract.modal_behavior: inset_suppressed_by_modal and world overlay remains off
zero_overlap_and_exclusion_contract.layout_failure_behavior: inset_layout_unavailable and world overlay remains off

required_positive_checks: reference panel and plot rectangles are physically exact
minimum 336x216 panel never underflows and plot remains 2:1
transparent cutout is an explicit draw-list region with zero opaque/UI coverage
title, bilingual orientation labels, ordered bilingual legend, toggle and border remain outside cutout
panel has zero overlap with every exclusion and safe/footer clearance is exact
default inset ON and world overlay OFF are independent state values
modal and collision suppression emit exact reasons without relocation or world fallback
CP1 four inventory rows and digests remain byte-exact
required_fail_closed_mutations: make one cutout pixel opaque or covered by a UI primitive
place border, title, label, legend or toggle inside plot
remove, reorder, mistranslate or denominator-count a bilingual label/legend entry
reduce panel below 336x216, distort plot from 2:1, or change reference rectangles
overlap any exclusion or violate right/footer clearance
relocate from camera or scene content
enable world overlay when inset is visible, suppressed, modal-blocked or layout-unavailable
change a file outside the future allowlist
